cards.text: Jesus has just called four fishermen to follow Him: the brothers Simon and Andrew, and the brothers James and John (Mark 1:16-20). Now they all head into Capernaum, and right away, on the Sabbath, Jesus walks into the synagogue and starts to teach. No warm-up, no small talk, straight to it.

cards.question: Jesus is teaching in the synagogue in Capernaum. The people there are ___ at His teaching.

cards.text: The writer tells us why: He taught “as one who had authority, and not as the scribes.” Me? I talk to my dough with authority every single morning, and it STILL does whatever it wants.
Then, suddenly, a man with an unclean spirit cries out right there in the synagogue: “What do You want with us, Jesus of Nazareth? Have You come to destroy us?…”

cards.question: The man with the unclean spirit tells Jesus, “I know who You are.” What does he call Jesus?

cards.text: But Jesus rebukes the spirit, right there in front of everybody.

cards.question: Jesus rebukes the unclean spirit in the synagogue. What does He command it?

answers.text: Be silent and come out of him
Tell Me your name right now

cards.text: The spirit throws the man into convulsions and comes out with a loud shriek. It leaves, but it does NOT leave quietly.

cards.question: After the unclean spirit comes out, the people in the synagogue call Jesus' teaching something new.
The amazed people in the synagogue ask one another what this is. They say Jesus ___ even the unclean spirits, and they ___ Him.

cards.text: Then the news about Jesus starts to spread. I bet nobody in that synagogue went home and talked about the weather.

cards.question: The news about Jesus starts to spread. How far does it go?

answers.text: Through the whole region of Galilee
Only around the town of Capernaum
All the way down into Egypt

cards.text: As soon as they leave the synagogue, Jesus and His companions head to the home of Simon and Andrew. James and John come along too.

cards.question: At Simon and Andrew's house, someone is sick in bed with a fever. Who is it?
Nobody tells Jesus about Simon's sick mother-in-law for a few days.

cards.text: So Jesus goes to her. He takes her by the hand and helps her up.

cards.question: When Jesus helps Simon's mother-in-law up, her fever leaves her.
With her fever gone, Simon's mother-in-law begins to ___ them.

cards.text: That evening, after sunset, people bring Jesus all the sick and demon-possessed.

cards.question: That evening, people bring all the sick and demon-possessed to Jesus, and the whole ___ gathers at the door.

cards.text: And Jesus heals many who are ill with various diseases and drives out many demons. Friend, that is one LONG evening.

cards.question: Jesus drives out many demons that evening, but He won't let them speak. Why not?

answers.text: Because they knew who He was
Because the crowd was too loud
Because it was still the Sabbath

cards.text: Early in the morning, while it's still dark, Jesus gets up and goes out to a solitary place. I spent years in the dark at the back of a junk drawer, and I never got one quiet night, because the dead batteries stuck in there with me argued NONSTOP.

cards.question: Early in the morning, while it's still dark, Jesus goes out to a solitary place to ___.

cards.text: Simon and his companions go looking for Him. Friend, I can't even find my apron in the morning, and it's TIED ON ME.

cards.question: When Simon and his companions find Jesus in the solitary place, what do they tell Him?

answers.text: The scribes want to see You

cards.question: Simon and his companions say everyone is looking for Jesus. What does Jesus say they should do?

answers.text: Go on to the neighboring towns to preach
Go back to Capernaum to heal everyone
Stay in this quiet place to pray longer

cards.question: Jesus tells Simon and his companions that preaching is why He has come.

cards.text: So He goes throughout Galilee, preaching in their synagogues and driving out demons. One town was never going to be big enough.
